title: sample-select/1: the sample ids a selection picks
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample select --json`: the ids `--sample LIST` or `--default` picks, ascending. An id the file does not have is exit 5 with an `error/1`. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/samples_cmd.rs. With `--ranges` it also carries the copy plan of the chosen samples (`bytes`, `total`, `tag`, `members`): the `[start, end)` byte ranges of each member the site copies into OPFS (code: crates/mzlab-core/src/readers/ranges.rs).

bytes.description: Bytes the ranges add up to.

tag.description: Hex name of the ranges: the same ranges give the same tag.
